boundary: A vehicle-corrected signature contrast in MCF7 and PC3 at 10.0 um and 24.0 h can challenge a target-specific pattern, but a mismatched compound is not a matched stress perturbation. Correlation does not identify the intended target, establish a disease mechanism or show that a compound is worth making.

enforced_rules.informative_control_undecided: If matched and mismatched rho are both at least 0.1 and mismatched rho is no greater than matched rho, the control also agrees and the case is undecided.
enforced_rules.low_correlation_undecided: A matched rho below 0.1 is uninformative and undecided, regardless of the mismatched rho.
enforced_rules.undecided_not_support: No undecided compound counts as mediator-specific support.

explanations.generic_stress: Any compound that perturbs the cell produces a similar change regardless of its target.
explanations.mediator_specific: The transcriptional change follows the compound acting through its intended target.

falsifying_observation.definition: Number of shared compounds with matched rho at least 0.1 and mismatched rho strictly greater than matched rho.
